predictions: Still one result outstanding from week 12, and another dumped to a match forfeit, so we sit at a plain 14-7 for the week to this point. Not too shabby, nothing to write home about, whatever. That brings my record for the season to 176-97 (64.5% correct). Importantly, I got both the Matt's Tab and the Uber Out picks correct, meaning that I only need to get one more right with each to avoid setting a personal record for my worst single-season pick rate with a single team. Yay?

Match of the week: (D Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ One Armed Bandits. With the Bandits going down last week, this pairing is now very likely a head-to-head tangle for the D division crown! Whoever wins here likely has to avoid a week 14 letdown/upset, but we'll just assume they'll handle that business. So, one match (probably) for it all! The Bandits have led almost all season… so I'll go with OC, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Double In, Uber Out. There are FOUR 8-4 teams leading B with only two weeks left! This race is awesome. This is this week's only pairing within the foursome, with the other two facing off next week, so this is sort of part one of a pair of elimination matches. Drama! Matt's Tab get payback, 13-11.

Match #3: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Village Idiots. This match was all poised to compete for the Match of the Week tag, then Sofa went and got dumped last week. Now instead this is the biggest hurdle for the Idiots as they try to lurk around in case Ton 80 Proof gets upset in the last two weeks. Sofa won last time, but I'm thinking it's Idiots, 14-10.

Matches #4 & #5: (A Div.) The Global Element @ Liver Alliance; The Bullies @ Lunatic Fringe. Element and The Bullies are both hoping to cruise into their week 14 showdown with big momentum, but both have one more serious hurdle to clear before then. Liver and Fringe are both deep and dangerous, so neither of the leaders can afford to let one slip here (well, ok, maybe Element actually could, but that's not a great strategy at almost any time). I think both leaders will get wins, but not without a bit of work. Liver is the league's clear #3, but Element takes it, 16-8; and The Bullies are just so deep and tough, 18-6.

Match #6: (B Div.) Iceman's Ear Defenders @ Dart Attack. I'm a bit stunned that this match could directly determine which team ends up in B's bottom two (and could subsequently be relegated to C next season). Iceman comes out on top here again, but only 13-11.

Match #7: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Armed & Hammered. With Armed taking out Inconsistent last week, the race among the lower half of A is all of a sudden very much on. Darty now controls their own fate in the race for 5th and the auto-staying in A. Darty, 14-10.

Match #8: (G Div.) Rippin Darts @ Nein Mark. Yeah, Rippin lost and hasn't "clinched" G yet, but this match is really about whether Nein Mark can do what Cork just did (beat Rippin) in the race for the #2 spot in G division. Alas, I think Rippin will be back. Rippin, 16-8.

Match #9: (C Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Double In Stumble Out. Show Me will almost certainly win C, even if they don't win either of their last two matches. But I'm sure they would rather just reel in a win here and be done with it. But Stumble Out is the only team to hold Show Me to a single-digit score this season. Still Show, 14-10.

Match #10: (G Div.) Ones Are Closed @ Punk in Drublic. The last four in G ALL have 7 losses at this point, so the race to avoid the league's cellar is maybe more exciting than it has ever been. Love this story this time. The Ones lead this pack so far, and win, 13-11.

Match #11: (D Div.) BullsHit @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Menace's big loss last week has likely ended their D title hopes. But that doesn't mean they won't be trying here just in case. They eke it out, 13-11.

Match #12: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Shoot-Da-Bull. We're short one wk12 result, but it's quite possible this is a head-to-head tilt to avoid a bottom-two spot in F (and possible slide to G). Shoot, 13-11.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Serious? 16, Boom Baby 8; Blindsided 13, Outlaws 11.
C Division: Nine Lives 14, McGavin 10; Sanchez 14, Rif Raf 10.
E Division: Hump Day! 14, Death Throw 10; Bad Mutha Duckas 15, Y.N.T.A. 9; Sharky's Machine 15, Irish Ton 9.
F Division: Ton 80 Proof 15, Knights 9; Dart Side 14, Bangin 10.
